g.text: or the fixture, or your HTTPS API
The message and the shopper's JWT go to the API
The API verifies the JWT and the session owner, then invokes the Runtime with it
The agent reads and writes the conversation events
The agent mints its own Gateway token: an on-behalf-of exchange
Gateway calls carry the agent's token, x-aria-actor-id and the trace ID, never the shopper's JWT
The interceptor and Cedar both allow; the target uses its own credential
Text, tool steps and product cards stream back as SSE
Reads the shopper's JWT and never forwards it
Indexing: scripts/index_catalog.sh puts your catalog JSON in S3; the Fargate task embeds it with Cohere Embed v4, loads OpenSearch and promotes the alias.
